from load_config import load_config


def test_regression_explicit_values_win_over_defaults():
    cfg = load_config({"host": "h", "port": 1, "timeout": 1, "retries": 0})
    assert cfg["timeout"] == 1 and cfg["retries"] == 0

Crash report: load_config indexed optional keys directly, so any config omitting timeout or retries raised KeyError. Fix: read optional keys with documented defaults (timeout 30, retries 3) while required keys still fail loudly when absent. Added a regression test proving explicit values, including zero, win over the defaults. All tests pass.
